content: अभिज्ञ {%a.%} [ज्ञा--क] .²1 Knowing, aware of, one who understands or is acquainted with, experiencing or having had experience of (with <ab>gen.</ab> or <ab>loc.</ab> in <ab>comp.</ab>); कान्तारवनदुर्गाणामभिज्ञा <ls>Rām. 4. 39. 28</ls>. यद्वा कौशलमिन्द्रसूनुदमने तत्राप्यभिज्ञो जनः <ls>U. 5. 34</ls>; अभिज्ञाच्छेदपातानां क्रियन्ते नन्दनद्रुमाः <ls>Ku. 2. 41</ls>; <ls>Me. 16</ls>; <ls>R. 7. 64</ls>; अनभिज्ञो भवान्सेवाधर्मस्य <ls>Pt. 1</ls>. .²2 Skilled in, conversant with, proficient, skilful, clever; यदि त्वमीदृशः कथायामभिज्ञः <ls>U. 4.</ls>, see अनभिज्ञ also. .{@-ज्ञः@} Brahmā, The Almighty; देहाद्यपार्थमसदन्त्यमभिज्ञमात्रं विन्देत ते तर्हि सर्वमनीषितार्थम् <ls>Bhāg. 12. 8. 44</ls>. .{@-ज्ञा@} .²1 Recognition. .²2 Remembrance, recollection; अभिज्ञावचने लृट् <ls>P. III. 2. 112</ls>. .²3 A supernatural faculty or power of which five kinds are usually mentioned:-- (1) taking any form at will; (2) hearing to any distance; (3) seeing to any distance; (4) penetrating menʼs thoughts; (5) knowing their state and antecedents. Monier Williams. <ab>cf.</ab> नामस्मृत्योरभिज्ञा स्यात् <ls>Nm.</ls>
